long_biography.plain_text:
Before entering private equity, Berman studied economics at the University of Virginia, earned an MBA at Wharton and advised Fortune 1000 companies at Bain & Company. Work across manufacturing, telecommunications and financial services taught him to examine operating problems across industries, a foundation for evaluating businesses rather than specializing in one commercial sector.

At H.I.G., he applied that breadth by directing more than forty acquisitions and later overseeing the day-to-day activity of multiple funds. He moved from responsibility for the lower-middle-market buyout fund to executive managing director, US strategy head and investment-committee member. His 2026 promotion widened the mandate again: as co-president, he now shares responsibility for discipline and execution across the broader firm.
